data.body: Completed Gerrit-host resize maintenance. Health: gerrit_healthy 200, reviewbot_healthy 200, MCP public 401 unauthenticated expected, live MCP backend health OK. Instance now reports r7g.large; CPUUtilization alarm rebar-gerrit-cpu-utilization-high present at 85% for 30 minutes.
